items.headline: UnitedHealthcare of Ohio Remains in State Marketplace for 2027
items.summary: UnitedHealthcare of Ohio, Inc. is confirmed as one of the five insurers remaining in the Ohio health insurance marketplace for the 2027 plan year following the withdrawal of other carriers.

items.headline: Humana Announces Pricing Terms of Offers to Purchase for Cash Certain of its Outstanding Debt Securities
items.summary: Humana Inc. has announced the reference yield and total consideration for its previously disclosed cash tender offers to purchase certain outstanding debt securities.

items.headline: Mubadala Investment Co. PJSC Increases Stake in UnitedHealth Group
items.summary: Mubadala Investment Co. PJSC has increased its shareholding in UnitedHealth Group Incorporated to 31,419 shares, according to a recent SEC filing.

items.headline: Bernstein Adjusts Price Target on Humana to $515 From $425
items.summary: Bernstein has increased its price target for Humana Inc. from $425 to $515.

items.headline: Bernstein Adjusts Price Target on Centene to $90 From $79
items.summary: Bernstein has increased its price target for Centene Corporation, raising it from $79 to $90.

items.headline: Molina Healthcare of Ohio to Exit State Health Insurance Marketplace
items.summary: Molina Healthcare of Ohio will discontinue its participation in the Ohio health insurance marketplace for the 2027 plan year.

items.headline: Oscar Health Appoints Three New Members to Board of Directors
items.summary: Oscar Health, Inc. has appointed Tomer Cohen, Eric Larsen, and Rajat Taneja to its Board of Directors, effective November 13, 2026.

items.headline: Senators Launch Inquiry into Health Insurers' Prior Authorization Pledges
items.summary: U.S. Senators have initiated inquiries with six major health insurance companies, including UnitedHealth Group, to demand updates on their 2025 commitments to reduce prior authorization practices.

items.headline: U.S. Senators Launch Inquiries with Health Insurers Regarding Prior Authorization Pledges
items.summary: U.S. Senators Jon Ossoff, Sheldon Whitehouse, and Ron Wyden have initiated inquiries with six major health insurance companies, including Elevance Health, to request updates on their 2025 commitments to reduce prior authorization practices.

items.headline: Senators Launch Inquiry into Health Insurers' Prior Authorization Pledges
items.summary: U.S. Senators have initiated inquiries with Humana and other major health insurers regarding their progress on pledges to reduce prior authorization practices.

items.headline: UHealth Adjusts Medicare Advantage Network for 2027
items.summary: The University of Miami Health System (UHealth) announced changes to its participating Medicare Advantage plans, which will impact Humana coverage starting in January 2027.

items.headline: Molina Healthcare Insider Sold Shares Worth $1,624,560
items.summary: An insider at Molina Healthcare, Inc. sold company shares valued at approximately $1.62 million, as disclosed in a recent SEC filing.

items.headline: Health Net Invests $3 Million in San Joaquin Regional Housing Fund
items.summary: Health Net, a Centene subsidiary, announced a $3 million investment to support the creation of affordable housing in Stockton, California.
